💡 perfectPixel | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To clean up and perfect AI-generated pixel art by automatically detecting and correcting distorted grids and pixel alignment.
✨ Key Features: • Automatically detect grid size from pixel style images • Refines AI generated pixel style image to perfectly aligned grids • Easy to integrate into your own workflow • Provides both OpenCV and Lightweight (NumPy only) implementations • Offers a ComfyUI custom node for workflow integration
📖 Summary: Perfect Pixel is a Python tool designed to automatically detect and refine AI-generated pixel art. It corrects distorted grids and ensures perfectly aligned pixels, making messy pixel art clean and usable.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 vigil-tui | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and analyzing real-time hardware power consumption and performance metrics directly within the terminal.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time wattage, thermals, clock speeds, and electricity cost monitoring for CPU, GPU, and RAM • Per-core utilization and frequency display • Process-level power estimation and ranking • Power and clock history charts (Braille area chart) • Throttle detection and alerts
📖 Summary: Vigil-tui is a real-time terminal dashboard for monitoring hardware power consumption, thermals, and performance metrics. It provides detailed insights into CPU, GPU, and RAM usage, along with process-level power estimation and cost analysis, all within a single command-line interface.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 homebox | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Home inventory and organization management.
✨ Key Features: • Rich Organization (categories, locations, tags, custom fields) • Powerful Search • Image Upload • Document and Warranty Tracking • Purchase & Maintenance Tracking
📖 Summary: HomeBox is a Go-based inventory and organization system designed for home users, prioritizing simplicity, speed, and portability. It offers features like categorization, powerful search, image uploads, and document tracking, all accessible via an embedded web UI and deployable with minimal resources.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 ya-music-desktop | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a desktop client for Yandex Music that allows users to download music and enhances the listening experience by blocking ads.
✨ Key Features: • Download music (tracks, albums, playlists) directly from the interface • Uses pywebview and Edge WebView2 for a desktop window • Downloads music in MP3 format (320/192/128 kbps) via yandex-music library • Applies ID3 tags and embeds cover art using mutagen
📖 Summary: YaMusic Desktop Client is a JavaScript-based desktop application that provides a wrapper around the Yandex Music web interface. It enhances the user experience by adding a download button for tracks, albums, and playlists, while also blocking ads and preserving user sessions.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 shok-monitor | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a comprehensive, agentless SOC and GRC platform for monitoring and securing IT infrastructure through SSH.
✨ Key Features: • Agentless monitoring via SSH • SOC & GRC workstation • Infrastructure monitoring (hosts, Docker, networks, live traffic) • Database monitoring and querying (39 engines) • Vulnerability and exposure scanning with remediation
📖 Summary: SHOK is a Windows desktop application that provides agentless Security Operations Center (SOC) and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) capabilities. It monitors infrastructure, databases, and performs vulnerability analysis and threat intelligence gathering solely over SSH, without installing any agents on remote systems.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 DracoLure | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To act as a deceptive honeypot that lures, detects, and mitigates cyber threats by analyzing and quarantining malicious network probes.
✨ Key Features: • Polyglot deception honeypot • Real-time request analysis and detection • Threat scoring and severity classification • Automatic quarantine and blocking of hostile sources • Serves believable bait (fake corporate portal, /.env, wp-login, etc.)
📖 Summary: DracoLure is a sophisticated Dragon Vector Honeypot designed to deceive, detect, score, and quarantine malicious network traffic in real-time. It serves believable bait to attackers, analyzes incoming requests against a signature library, assigns threat scores, and automatically blocks hostile sources.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
